summary: Tested (1) new Master File sections (Customer Names w/ contact_no, Executive Names, Team Managers) backend CRUD + UI, (2) MIS Board column freeze now stopping at Status, (3) MIS Add Entry dropdowns with customer contact auto-fill. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed for /api/master/customers|executives|managers (GET arrays, POST, PUT, DELETE, duplicate 400, missing-name 400, auth required, no _id leakage). Frontend: all 3 sections render at top of Master File in correct order; customer dialog has Name + Contact Number (contact input absent for executives/managers as expected); Rahul Test/9998887770, Executive Test, Manager Test added and displayed (contact shown under name). Month MIS Apr-2026: exactly 7 columns are sticky (month, customer_name, company_name, contact_no, bank, login_date, status) with correct cumulative left offsets; amount/sanction/disbursed and all later columns are position:static and scroll normally (verified at scrollLeft=600). Add Entry form shows Select comboboxes for Customer Name ('Rahul Test (9998887770)'), Executive Name, Team Manager; selecting a customer auto-filled Contact Number = 9998887770. One UX defect found in Edit Entry form (existing values not shown in the new dropdowns).

ui_bugs.issue: Customer Name / Executive Name / Team Manager Select triggers render completely EMPTY (not even placeholder) when the existing entry value is not present in the new master lists (e.g. row 'Vishwa' with executive 'Rajan', manager 'Dimple'). Admin cannot see the current value of a required field, and would have to re-pick a master value; risk of confusion/perceived data loss. Suggest showing the existing value as a selected/extra SelectItem or falling back to a text input when the value is not in the master list.

issues: Success toast reads 'Customer Name added' (derived from section title) — slightly awkward wording; expected 'Customer added'
Pre-existing: long cell text overflows into adjacent column (e.g. 'SEPL Income Programme' overlapping 'Mumbai' in Location) — no truncation on Scheme column

action_items: Handle legacy/non-master values in MIS Edit Entry dropdowns for customer_name, executive_name, team_manager (show current value or allow free text)
Optional: fix Master File toast wording; truncate long Scheme cell text
critical_code_review_comments: MonthlyMIS.jsx edit form binds editFormData.customer_name/executive_name/team_manager to Radix Select value; Radix renders placeholder/empty when value is absent from SelectItem set — add the current value as an option to avoid invisible state.
Backend master CRUD endpoints use raw Request/dict instead of Pydantic models (no validation on contact_no format/length); consider a Pydantic model for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Master data added via UI (left in place per test request): Customer 'Rahul Test' (9998887770), Executive 'Executive Test', Manager 'Manager Test'. Pytest-created TEST_* records were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Freeze verification approach: expand month via [data-testid='month-header-Apr-2026'], then evaluate computed position/left of [data-testid^='mis-th-Apr-2026-'] headers. Expected sticky set = month, customer_name, company_name, contact_no, bank, login_date, status. New master endpoints covered by /app/backend/tests/test_master_customers_execs_managers.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Edit-form empty dropdowns: Radix UI Select only displays a value that matches one of its SelectItem values; legacy MIS entries contain customer/executive/manager names that were never added to the new master collections, so the trigger renders blank.
